tèbié — especially; special: yìzhí — all along; continuously; straight ahead
huòzhě — or (in statements; use 还是 in questions)
búdàn… érqiě… — not only… but also…
yuè lái yuè — more and more (越来越冷 = colder and colder)
wèile — in order to; for the sake of
bǎ — moves the object before the verb (把门关上 = shut the door)
bèi — passive marker (蛋糕被他吃了 = the cake was eaten by him)
